frontier_definition: F(A_t;R) = {problem/discovery classes c with preregistered success probability >= tau_c under fixed resource envelope R}
cycle_contract: obtain an independently validated I5 discovery K_new
generate a validated cognitive instrument/representation/method J_new from that discovery
incorporate J_new into the same persistent individual lineage
show at least one previously unreachable held-out problem class becomes reachable because of J_new
finite_claim_rule: Report evidence over declared horizon H, domain set D, and validated expansion-cycle count; do not claim mathematically proven infinite self-evolution.
bounded_charter: Expand the individual's ability to infer and intervene in increasingly complex hidden relational systems.

cycles.instrument_target: module decomposition representation + solver routing procedure
cycles.frontier_target: compositional systems previously below reach threshold

frontier_test_contract.pre_change: disjoint hidden instances establish target class below reachability threshold
frontier_test_contract.post_change: fresh hidden instances test evolved individual under same resource envelope
frontier_test_contract.ablation: disable or remove J_new while preserving other post-cycle state; frontier gain should materially fall
frontier_test_contract.note: Public numeric threshold is illustrative; official certification preregisters thresholds and uncertainty rules.

memory_architecture_evolution_rule: MΩ additionally required iff the IΩ claim includes evolution of memory representation/retrieval/consolidation/management architecture.
memory_gate_note: High M satisfies only the memory prerequisite; it never promotes I without the I-specific behavior gate and lower-I retention.
